summary: Verified TBS GoHub demo tab end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 gohub tests pass, /api/admin/gohub/probe returns dry-run response with qr_string:null + qr_png_data_url:null and steps flagged dry_run:true when GOHUB_ENABLED=false. Toggled GOHUB_ENABLED=true and confirmed live TBS returns 'Invalid Server IP' cleanly captured as steps[0].ok=false with error.code and message containing 'Invalid Server IP' (expected — cluster IP not whitelisted). Reverted the flag afterwards. Regression endpoints (/api/health, admin login, /api/admin/routes, /api/admin/terminals) all 200. Frontend: admin login → /admin → gohub-test tab loads, form fields (trip, seat, from_counter, to_counter, run button) all present and interactive, clicking Run TBS Probe renders the SOAP trace showing dry_run:true, no ticket rendered (expected), other admin tabs (routes/stops/add-schedule/schedules/bookings) still switch without hard errors.

Our endpoint captures the shape correctly (ok:false, error.code, error.message with 'Invalid Server IP'). Just a doc-vs-reality delta — the endpoint behaviour is correct.
